name: hv18_vmdel_lane2-q2-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-B-RTL1 2026-10-17 (owner 0do, plan (b) d4g): the per-QUADRANT VM delivery lane, NPC 2 (ot_hbm_svc_vmdel_lane_n): each 4-SM quadrant fills its own 8 banks from its own 16 PCs, so a lane holds 2 PC landing SRAMs (slot g = SM group 2g+b/4 of the quadrant, controller lane b%4) and delivers 64 slots x 2 groups (1024 sectors) per block into bank b. 32 instances (8 per quadrant), replacing the 16 d4f hv17 lanes. Same pins rules as hv17 v6 (plain pin flop on every input incl. rst_n / bank_id / status, synchronous body reset, status reduced after capture, one clock root); LAT 2, STATUS_LAT 2, II 1.
